title: Debate, Deliberate, Decide (D3): A Cost-Aware Adversarial Framework for Reliable and Interpretable LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating candidate answers twice by swapping their presentation order (A, B versus B, A) and measuring the consistency of the evaluator's final verdict (Positional Swap Consistency).

Calculating the percentage of instances where an evaluator model unfairly prefers answers generated by its own model family over others, contradicting ground-truth human preference labels (Self-Enhancement Rate).
